concerns.text: FR-002 (filter courses with <50 learners) and SC-004 (≥10k records) lack a completed task. T019 (exclude courses <50) and T020 (generate learners_raw.csv) are unchecked. Without these, the data pipeline cannot satisfy the 'Data Hygiene' constraint or the Success Criteria for US1.

FR-003 (Interval Calculation) and FR-004 (Binning Logic) have no completed implementation tasks. T024 (median calculation), T025 (binning logic), and T026 (generate learners_binned.csv) are unchecked. The core statistical grouping required for US2 is missing.

FR-005 (Cluster-Robust OLS) and FR-006 (Tukey HSD) are unsupported by completed tasks. T030 (Cohen's d/p-values) and T031 (Tukey HSD) are unchecked. The statistical modeling required for US3 cannot be executed.

FR-007 (Sensitivity Analysis) is incomplete. T033 (significance stability), T034 (flip rate), T036 (report generation), and T037 (verification) are unchecked. The robustness check required by SC-003 is missing.

FR-008 (Proxy Validation) has no completed task. T039 (Reference-Validator Agent execution) is unchecked, violating Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) and the spec's explicit validation requirement.
T009 (schema validation utilities) is unchecked. This blocks the implementation of data hygiene and schema validation required by Constitution Principle III and the plan's contract definitions.
T041 (README) and T042 (API docs) are unchecked. This violates Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) which requires documented usage instructions for a fresh runner.
